name: Delfina Octopus Charm
description: This Delfina octopus charm in tomato red doubles as a keychain and features a heart-shaped push-in clasp, a knotted-rope detail and bead embellishments. Use it to add a playful touch to your everyday bag.

name: Delfina Dolphin Charm
description: This Delfina dolphin charm in butter yellow doubles as a keychain and features a round push-in clasp, a lobster clasp, stitch trims and studded details. Whether you use it as a bag charm or as a keyring, it will add a whimsical touch to your daily routine.

name: Sable Knot Rectangular Sunglasses
description: These Sable rectangular sunglasses in black feature rope-knot details on gold-tone metallic arms and classic angular frames. Bring this pair with you every day to protect your eyes from UV rays -- they will also instantly elevate any outfit you have on.

name: Rose Charm
description: This whimsical and feminine charm and keychain features a cream rose, a pink rose and a mint-green leaf that are made with smooth faux leather. Use it to add a touch of charm and elegance to your everyday routine.

name: Alix Butterfly Sunglasses
description: These Alix sunglasses in black feature butterfly-shaped frames, metallic accents and tinted lenses. Pair them with structured outerwear for a bold and contemporary aesthetic.

name: Ivette Woven Robot Bag Charm
description: This Ivette bag charm in pink is shaped like a boxy robot and features a woven body. Clip it onto your bag of choice to introduce a playful element to your everyday ensembles.

name: Leighton Square Sunglasses
description: Black sunglasses are timeless accessories. These Leighton square sunglasses are perfect for accentuating and framing your face. The gold-accented temples add a hint of shine while the tinted lenses provide UV protection.

name: Pearl Beaded-Strap Furry Ball Charm
description: Add a subtle pop of colour to your look with this light blue furry ball charm. Attach it to your go-to tote or hang it from the belt loop of your favourite jeans with its handy clip ring -- the styling possibilities are endless.

name: Nyra Sculptural Drop Earrings - Gold
description: Make a bold statement with these gold Nyra drop earrings. Their fluid lines and sculptural design exude effortless sophistication -- they will lend a polished and understated edge to any outfit.

name: Nyra Sculptural Drop Earrings - Silver
description: These Nyra drop earrings put a contemporary twist on your classic drop earrings. The polished silver finish and sleek, sculptural design makes them the perfect accerssory to elevate any outfit with understated edge.

name: Evangeline Turquoise Crystal Ring - Silver
description: You can count on this Evangeline ring to add a vibrant pop of colour to any look. It features a sparkling turquoise faux crystal as its focus, which is complemented by a silver-tone stainless steel band.

name: Evangeline Turquoise Crystal Ring - Gold
description: You can always count on this Evangeline ring to add a touch of sparkle and sculptural detail to any look. Featuring a large clear crystal and a gold-tone finish, it is classy and glamorous at once. Pair it with the other pieces from the Evangeline line to create a striking combination.

name: Evangeline Clear Crystal Drop Earrings - Gold
description: Sometimes, all you need is a little sparkle to bring your entire look together -- and these Evangeline drop earrings will do that with effortless elegance. The large white faux crystals are complemented by gold-tone settings to create a minimalist yet glamorous design.

name: Evangeline Clear Crystal Drop Earrings - Silver
description: Let these sculptural drop earrings bring a touch of artful elegance to your look. The eye-catching turquoise crystals will perfectly complement vibrant personalities and are sure to lift the mood of anyone who sees them.

name: Corrine Pearl Sculptural Drop Earrings - Gold
description: Featuring lustrous pearls nestled between sculptural pillars and accented with additional pearl details, these drop earrings make a subtle yet striking statement. The understated brushed gold finish adds versatility -- perfect for everyday wear.

name: Corrine Pearl Sculptural Drop Earrings - Silver
description: Add an artful touch to your everyday ensemble with the Corrine drop earrings, featuring lustrous pearls nestled between sculptural pillars that are accented with additional pearls. The understated silver finish adds versatility.

name: Corrine Pearl Sculptural Ring - Gold
description: This sculptural ring stands out with its distinctive silhouette. Eye-catching pearl accents add an elegant touch to its understated brushed gold finish, making it perfect for stacking with other minimalist rings.

name: Corrine Pearl Sculptural Ring - Silver
description: Add an artful touch to your everyday ensemble with the Corrine necklace, featuring a sculptural silhouette embellished with elegant pearl accents. Perfect for stacking, it is an ideal piece to create a personalised look.

name: Orinda Crystal Drop Earrings - Gold
description: Tastefully subtle, these Orinda earrings will elevate your looks. The drop design features organic shapes and star motifs to create a distinctive design. They are also flattering as they will streamline your face.

name: Orinda Crystal Drop Earrings - Silver
description: Add this elegant pair of earrings to your collection. They feature star motifs and organic shapes in a drop style, which is flattering as it will streamline your face. In classic silver, they will complement most outfits with ease.

name: Orinda Crystal Sculptural Ring - Gold
description: This Orinda ring in gold is a small accessory that makes a big impression. Studded with white crystals of varying sizes, this sculptural design will add an artful touch to all your outfits.

name: Orinda Crystal Sculptural Ring - Silver
description: Make a subtle but striking statement with this Orinda ring in shiny silver. Studded with multi-coloured crystals of varying sizes, this sculptural design will add an artful touch to all your outfits.

name: Orinda Crystal Starfish Stud Earrings - Silver
description: Glamorous with a seaside-inspired twist, the Orinda earrings are perfect for summer. Multi-coloured faux crystals add extra shine to the silver-tone finish of the starfish silhouette. Wear them on their own or stacked with other pieces from the Orinda collection to complete your looks.

name: Bijou Cateye Sunglasses
description: What is summer without a pair of fun sunglasses? These Bijou sunglasses with an ombre beige-pink finish will add a bright touch of colour to enhance your warm weather outfits. The sleek, angular cat-eye silhouette is chic and contemporary.

name: Crochet Flower Beaded Charm
description: Give your bags a soft, romantic touch with this beaded charm. The combination of a crochet flower and pearlescent beads creates an interplay of textures that will add interest to your bags.

name: Edie Oval Sunglasses
description: For a clean look, the Edie sunglasses are the way to go. The sleek style is adorned with metallic accents on the sides, which creates a distinctively edgy design. In chalk, they will match effortlessly with many ensembles.

name: Crystal Double-Row Eternity Ring - Silver
description: With this ring, you can add a touch of sparkle to your everyday outfit or use it to enhance a standout party ensemble. Featuring not one, but two rows of sparkling crystals, it reflects light beautifully from every angle. Wear the ring solo for an understated look, or pair it with the matching crystal tennis bracelet and necklace from our 2024 Holiday Collection for a dazzling appearance.

name: Hoop Earrings - Gold
description: Everybody needs a staple pair of hoops, and this pair is as classic as it gets. The dainty silhouette will elevate your ensembles in an understated way and go well with everything. Wear these brush gold hoop earrings on their own to polish up your everyday looks.

name: Hoop Earrings - Silver
description: Simple accessories go a long way in adding sophistication to any look. Wear these silver hoop earrings on their own to polish up your everyday looks, or explore our full range of jewellery charms (subject to market availability) for a personalised touch.

name: Tricha Turn-Lock Wallet
description: This compact Tricha wallet in black features a front flap with a turn-lock closure, stitch-trim detailing and a minimalist, clean-lined silhouette. Use it to keep your note bills, cards and coins organised and secure.

name: Briony Curved Flap Wallet
description: Make wineberry red your new neutral -- it adds a touch of sophistication to the Briony curved flap wallet, which features a compact size that belies its functionality. Opening to reveal multiple card slots and compartments, it will keep your essentials neatly organised, with a rear patch pocket for securing loose change.

name: Harmonee Top-Zip Small Wallet
description: This Harmonee small wallet in taupe features a compact silhouette with a fold-over design, a snap-button closure and a top-zip compartment. Sitting comfortably in the palm of your hand, it will be a chic companion for lunch breaks and errand runs.

name: Carli Multi-Slot Card Holder
description: This Carli card holder in soft pink features multiple card slots, stitch-trim details, a back zip compartment, a slim rectangular profile and gold-tone logo for a hint of shine. Carry it in the palm of your hand during quick errand runs or slip it into your pocket.

name: Behn Small Wallet
description: This Behn small wallet in shell grey features a fold-over design, a secure zip compartment and a striking gold-tone buckle at its centre for a touch of shine. It will add an elegant element to your everyday routine.

name: Ciara Top-Zip Card Holder
description: This Ciara card holder in burgundy features a top-zip closure, a duo-heart charm, intricate knot details and multiple card slots. It will elevate your everyday routine with its rich colour and elegant details.

name: Briony Curved Flap Long Wallet
description: It does not get more classic than a long wallet with a magnetic flap closure. This version, in a distinctive wineberry red, stands out with its unique colourway. Inside, multiple compartments and card slots will help keep your essentials neatly organised while exuding effortless style.

name: Bliss Snap Button Card Holder
description: For a timeless addition to any accessory collection, a black card holder is always a good idea. Ultra-compact and lightweight, this piece may look small but it certainly packs a punch. It features a bi-fold design that opens to reveal more card slots and inner patch pockets while the snap-button closure will ensure your items are kept securely in place.
